task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Solve a 0/1 knapsack (values [7, 11, 9, 7, 2, 8], weights [3, 2, 1, 1, 3, 7], capacity 11) by building a penalized QUBO in dimod (slack-variable encoding for the capacity constraint) and sampling with SimulatedAnnealingSampler. Compare to brute force. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
